queryText:
SELECT *, CASE
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%coffee mug%' THEN 'coffee mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%tea cup%' THEN 'tea cup'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%gift hamper%' THEN 'gift hamper'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap holder%' THEN 'soap holder'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap%' THEN 'soap'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%necklace%' THEN 'necklace'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%planter%' THEN 'planter'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%mug%' THEN 'mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%cup%' THEN 'cup'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END AS primary_product_type,
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) = $1 THEN 1000
                        WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $2 THEN 900
                        WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 800
                        WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $3 THEN 700
                        WHEN FALSE THEN 500
                        WHEN FALSE THEN 400
                        WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 300
                        WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(description), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(description), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 100
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) + CASE WHEN CASE
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%coffee mug%' THEN 'coffee mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%tea cup%' THEN 'tea cup'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%gift hamper%' THEN 'gift hamper'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap holder%' THEN 'soap holder'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap%' THEN 'soap'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%necklace%' THEN 'necklace'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%planter%' THEN 'planter'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%mug%' THEN 'mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%cup%' THEN 'cup'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END = 'soap' THEN 150 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap holder%' OR trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%gift hamper%' OR trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%bathroom%' THEN -500 WHEN CASE
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%coffee mug%' THEN 'coffee mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%tea cup%' THEN 'tea cup'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%gift hamper%' THEN 'gift hamper'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap holder%' THEN 'soap holder'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%soap%' THEN 'soap'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%necklace%' THEN 'necklace'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%planter%' THEN 'planter'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%mug%' THEN 'mug'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE '%cup%' THEN 'cup'
                    ELSE 'other'
                END <> 'soap' THEN -150 ELSE 0 END AS relevance,
                CASE
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) = $1 THEN 'Exact Name'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $2 THEN 'Starts With Name'
                    WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 'All Tokens In Name'
                    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $3 THEN 'Contains Name'
                    WHEN FALSE THEN 'SKU'
                    WHEN FALSE THEN 'Tags'
                    WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 'Category'
                    WHEN (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(description), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(description), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0) THEN 'Description'
                    ELSE 'Other'
                END AS matched_field FROM products WHERE (
                    trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) = $1
                    OR trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $2
                    OR (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0)
                    OR trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(name), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE $3
                    OR FALSE
                    OR FALSE
                    OR (POSITION('heal' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0 AND POSITION('soap' IN trim(regexp_replace(replace(lower(category), 'kottravai', ' '), '[^a-z0-9\s]+', ' ', 'g'))) > 0)
                ) AND is_live = TRUE ORDER BY relevance DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
